title: Two for the Dough
author: Janet Evanovich
summary: New Jersey bounty hunter Stephanie Plum is chasing a cousin of her ex-fling who has skipped bail, as shootings and a stolen collection of headstones add up. Her grandmother adds chaos.
readIf: you want a light, comic mystery with a very chaotic heroine.
skipIf: you like realistic procedural detail and careful plotting.
